lox.method: Three alternating observations. Fresh private guest caches followed by warm replay; OS/shared host-tool caches are not flushed. Admission wait excluded. Instrumentation disabled.
lox.rss_limit: GNU time maximum RSS for the build command and its waited children, not a summed concurrent process-tree or cgroup peak.

eda.method: Three alternating observations. Fresh private guest caches followed by warm replay; OS/shared host-tool caches are not flushed. Admission wait excluded. Instrumentation disabled.
eda.rss_limit: GNU time maximum RSS for the build command and its waited children, not a summed concurrent process-tree or cgroup peak.

overlap_resolution: Whole chunk interval only; exact individual launch times unavailable. Possible overlap is conservative, not proof of contention.

archive.note: Coordinator verification metadata pinned; archive not rehashed/recompressed by synthesis.
